facts.high-ground: A young man standing high on a green hill holds a wand slanted across with both hands to block the way.
facts.six-below: Six wands rise toward him from below.
facts.mismatched-shoes: He wears a low shoe on one foot and a boot on the other, so the shoes do not match.
facts.blue-sky: The background is a blue sky.

glosses.mismatched-shoes: A fight that came up suddenly; holding on even when not perfectly ready.
glosses.six-below: Pressure and opposing opinions coming from several directions.

reversedGloss.waning: The strength to hold on drains, and he wants to back away.
reversedGloss.excess: Hearing every word as an attack, and defending too much.

misdescriptions.wrong: Several people climb the hill and attack.
He blocks with a sword and shield.
